body:
Founder: 'last time i checked it was 1v1 no card interface please do really hard to check.' Code audit confirms Phase 2 (2026-08-27/28, before this session) really did wire the 16-card catalog into a real in-match input path: V cycles/G casts, same SDL dispatch block as Q/W/R, real PACKET_ARENA_CARD_PLAY networked path, same server dispatch switch as Q/W/R, 15 passing test functions covering the full logic. Confirmed the real 1v1 matchmaker flow launches the same client binary. No ownership/collection gating exists -- every card already available to every user. No code changes, audit only.

⚓ ☃
title: Verified the 16-card system is real, wired end-to-end, and available to all users -- not a stub
